_note: ROUND_46 P0 model cards. Structured is a single internal test split; text is sibling-aware groupwise OOF (the only citable Chinese text generalization protocol); physiological is a 157-row deterministic split; English is a cross-lingual holdout from the same Reddit domain. No production artifact or threshold was modified.

metrics.auprc: sklearn average_precision_score; compare with positive_rate baseline, not 0.5
metrics.auprc_artifact_discrepancy: physiological metrics.json 0.8919 uses a custom precision[:-1] step integral; standard AP on identical predictions is 0.8961 (definition only)
metrics.brier: mean((p-y)^2); report brier_skill versus prevalence-only baseline
metrics.calibration: Platt slope/intercept on logit(p); ideal slope=1, intercept=0
metrics.ppv_npv: Bayes reweighted to stated prevalence; test prevalence is not deployment prevalence
metrics.bootstrap: percentile bootstrap, B=5000 for main units; text resamples groups

calibration_candidate.method: Platt on validation split, applied to test (no test fit)
5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold cross-fitted Platt on OOF probabilities

leaky_textwise_contrast.why: text-level OOF lets sibling variants cross folds; it is the leakage-inflated protocol.

text_english_holdout.boundary: Same Reddit domain as training, not a clinical or new-population external validation.

physio_v2_current_split.auprc_gap_note: metrics.json records a custom step integral using precision[:-1] (v1_29/04 auprc_score); standard sklearn average_precision_score on the same 157 predictions is higher. Definition difference only, same predictions.

calibration_candidate.method: Platt on 153 validation rows, applied to 157 test rows (exploratory only)

physio_v2_current_split.boundary: n=157; bootstrap CI is wide. Do not cite as a stable external-validation estimate.

fusion.reason: No aligned three-modality labelled samples exist; modality datasets come from different populations.
fusion.boundary: Do not infer fusion performance, modality contribution, or DCA from synthetic score grids.
